What is the best hospital on Koh Samui? | For serious injuries and complex care, Bangkok Hospital Samui on the ring road near Chaweng Noi has the widest range of specialists, including a trauma unit and paediatrics. For everyday problems the nearest private hospital is fine, and the government Koh Samui Hospital near Nathon is the low-cost option.
Is there a 24-hour hospital on Koh Samui? | Yes. Bangkok Hospital Samui, Samui International, Thai International, Bandon International and Wattanapat all run 24-hour emergency departments, as does the government Koh Samui Hospital near Nathon.
What number do I call for an ambulance in Thailand? | Dial 1669 for the national emergency medical service, which is free and takes you to the nearest suitable hospital. Private hospitals also send their own billed ambulances; Bangkok Hospital Samui's local hotline is 1719.
Should I go to a government or private hospital on Koh Samui? | Private hospitals are faster, closer to the east-coast resorts and used to foreign insurers, but expensive. The government Koh Samui Hospital is much cheaper (a ward bed is 330 THB a day) and handles serious cases, but expect queues and less English at reception.
Do hospitals on Koh Samui accept travel insurance? | Yes. Private hospitals contact your insurer for a guarantee of payment, and some have direct-billing agreements. Without a guarantee, they ask for a deposit before admission. Bring your policy number and the insurer's 24-hour assistance line.
How much does a hospital visit cost on Koh Samui? | It varies widely. The government hospital publishes 330 THB a day for a ward bed and 2,000–3,500 THB for a private room, plus treatment. Private hospitals cost several times more; ask for a written estimate and an itemised bill.
~What should I do if I'm stung by a jellyfish? | Get out of the water, keep still, pour vinegar over the sting for at least 30 seconds, don't rub it or rinse with fresh water, and call 1669. Go to hospital for severe pain, breathing problems or confusion.
Is there a decompression chamber on Koh Samui? | Yes. SSS Network / Hyperbaric Services Thailand runs a recompression chamber in Bophut that treats divers from Samui, Koh Phangan and Koh Tao. Your dive centre and dive insurer will arrange the referral.
Do doctors on Koh Samui speak English? | Yes, at the private hospitals doctors and front-desk staff speak English. At the government hospital most doctors speak English, but nurses and reception staff may not.
Where do patients from Koh Phangan go for serious treatment? | Serious cases from Koh Phangan and Koh Tao are transferred to Koh Samui by boat and ambulance. Koh Samui Hospital is the public referral hospital for the three islands, and Samui's private hospitals also accept transfers.
